summary.grain: one mining run (or benchmark summary); no feature-level metrics

status.meaning: summary success/no_rules；候选 selected/rejected/candidate/deferred；评估 ok/unobserved/empty；结合 reason 和 rejection_stage

candidate_count.meaning: 候选审计行数；cascade 包含同一 rule_id 在不同轮次的审计，不是去重规则数

selected_count.meaning: 最终 RuleSet 中入选规则数；no_rules 为 0

validation_status.meaning: independent 或 in_sample；验证样本独立性由调用方保证

profile.meaning: 实际 explore / production 门禁；报告不改阈值

qualification.meaning: 计算时 RuleSet 资格；快照恢复不会重建部署资格

field_defaults.null: unavailable; inspect status and report parameters

candidates.grain: candidate rule_id / generation_round when present; generator audit

rule_id.meaning: 规范 DSL 的稳定哈希 ID；同 ID 可出现在不同 dataset、target 或轮次

expression.meaning: 既有 DSL 规范表达式；不执行报告文本

sources.meaning: 候选生成器／seed 来源；不是 feature_metadata.data_source

distinct_source_count.meaning: 实际 distinct_source_count 整数计数；粒度见本表 grain

exact_duplicate_count.meaning: 实际 exact_duplicate_count 整数计数；粒度见本表 grain

within_candidate_budget.meaning: 实际 within_candidate_budget 门禁结果；null 表示未执行或不适用

candidate_filter_passed.meaning: 实际 candidate_filter_passed 门禁结果；null 表示未执行或不适用

validation_filter_passed.meaning: 实际 validation_filter_passed 门禁结果；null 表示未执行或不适用

iou_filter_passed.meaning: 实际 iou_filter_passed 门禁结果；null 表示未执行或不适用

selection_rank.meaning: 实际选择顺序；未入选为 null

status.meaning: summary success/no_rules；候选 selected/rejected/candidate/deferred；评估 ok/unobserved/empty；结合 reason 和 rejection_stage

reason.meaning: 真实候选淘汰原因；错误不转换为 no_rules

source_position.meaning: 实际 source_position 候选顺序；null 表示不适用

budget_position.meaning: 实际 budget_position 候选顺序；null 表示不适用

budget_strategy.meaning: 已保存的 budget_strategy；未登记业务含义保持 unknown

q_value.meaning: 同数据范围、target、slice、group 候选检验族 BH 校正 q 值

lift_ci_lower.meaning: 规则 Wilson 事件率下界 / 同范围总体事件率；保守 Lift 下界

lift_ci_upper.meaning: 规则 Wilson 事件率上界 / 同范围总体事件率；保守 Lift 上界

temporal_assessed.meaning: 实际 temporal_assessed 门禁结果；null 表示未执行或不适用

temporal_passed.meaning: 实际 temporal_passed 门禁结果；null 表示未执行或不适用

time_slice_count.meaning: 实际 time_slice_count 整数计数；粒度见本表 grain

time_slice_pass_rate.meaning: 通过时间切片数 / 已评估时间切片数

roles.rule_id: 规范 DSL 的稳定哈希 ID；同 ID 可出现在不同 dataset、target 或轮次

field_defaults.null: unavailable; inspect status and report parameters

description.saved_operations: public functions accept load_report ReportSnapshot; no source samples or fitted objects required
limitations: Only saved aggregate evidence; no causal or deployment conclusion.
Null is unavailable, not numeric zero. See status and denominators.
Feature matching uses rule membership union; features AND sources may match different features of the same rule. sources is business data_source, not candidate generators.
summary and benchmark do not support features/sources queries. Advanced analysis scope is advanced_analysis; no dataset identity is inferred for supplied analysis samples.
Absent analyses are not computed; present zero-row tables are computed_empty unless explicitly not_computed. Null may be undefined or unconfigured; inspect parameters and denominators.
Snapshot is aggregate evidence, not RuleSet JSON, transform capability or deployment permission. No original samples or models are saved.
